qwen3_asr_repo.finding: Official Qwen3-ASR streaming inference is implemented through the vLLM backend; the streaming demo initializes Qwen3ASRModel streaming state and incrementally calls streaming_transcribe.

vllm.current_supported_models_doc_observation: Qwen3ASRForConditionalGeneration is supported and the Realtime Transcription section lists Qwen3ASRRealtimeGeneration for Qwen/Qwen3-ASR-0.6B. Serving the realtime architecture requires an explicit hf-overrides architecture selection.
vllm.current_cpu_support_doc_observation: The current Intel Xeon CPU supported-model matrix does not list Qwen3ASRForConditionalGeneration or Qwen3ASRRealtimeGeneration. Absence from the matrix is treated as lack of documented CPU support, not proof of impossibility.

hypothesis: The official Qwen3-ASR realtime path can improve partial-transcript behavior only if the target can host a supported vLLM realtime runtime; on the current 4-vCPU no-CUDA target, backend/platform fit is likely to be the blocker before ASR quality is even measured.
counterhypothesis: vLLM CPU can run Qwen3ASRRealtimeGeneration despite the missing current CPU support-matrix entry, with acceptable memory and latency on clay-direct-dev.
discriminator: Do not mint streaming credit from source support. If Trigger4 chooses to probe the official realtime successor, first perform a bounded fail-closed vLLM CPU architecture/load preflight on the exact target with no model/API network inference and strict RAM/startup caps; only proceed to audio streaming if Qwen3ASRRealtimeGeneration actually initializes. Otherwise retain the current German comparator path and do not spend further target time on vLLM realtime there.
reason: The current target has no CUDA and only four logical CPUs. The existing positive receipt covers Transformers CPU load/inference, not the official vLLM streaming runtime. Current upstream documentation establishes realtime architecture availability but does not document Qwen3-ASR on the vLLM CPU support matrix.
next_exact_action: Keep the already-routed pinned FLEURS + non-speech Qwen3-ASR versus faster-whisper comparator as the primary target discriminator. Treat official Qwen vLLM realtime as a separate bounded support preflight only after the comparator result or when a GPU-capable admitted target is available.
